claims.evidence: The duration of use cannot be determined from static photos of the exterior.
The witness report explicitly states that the working condition and stitch quality were not shown.

risks.risk: Clutch motor may be burnt out or excessively noisy.
risks.proof: A video clip of the motor running and the machine sewing.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical wear or timing issues.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine stitching through fabric without skipping stitches.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a major mechanical overhaul.

risks.risk: Oil pump failure or contaminated oil reservoir.
risks.proof: A photo of the oil pan under the machine head showing clean oil and the pump intake.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and sewing a sample of fabric.
Photo of the oil reservoir pan underneath the machine head.
Clear audio of the motor running to check for bearing noise.
response.reason: The witness has clearly identified the brand and model as an EMEL EM-8500. It can be priced at its worst-case (non-working) value until functionality is proven.
